objective: Freeze distinct scorer-harness and provider-facing source-held-out roles before candidate qualification.

development_harness.reason: Contains opaque fixture-local identifiers that are intentionally retained for regression compatibility but are not fair source-only provider targets.

separation_rules: The candidate provider consumes only task plus authorized source text plus source digest at extraction time.
Gold labels, forbidden labels, and corpus case identifiers may not be used as extraction features.
Case identifiers may be echoed only for receipt correlation and must not alter predictions.
No user manuscript or hidden Book-Eval evidence is present in either corpus.
No named-author imitation target or bulk copyrighted reference body is present.
The synthetic source-held-out set is sufficient for first provider plumbing/calibration but is not a substitute for later public-domain or human-adjudicated held-out evidence.
